target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #97074.

When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, Feishu renders a single `\n` as a space. This causes assistant responses with multiple paragraphs or structured lines to appear cramped and unreadable.

## Why This Change Was Made

`buildFeishuPostMessagePayload()` normalizes the markdown text before sending:

- Single newlines outside fenced code blocks are upgraded to paragraph breaks (`\n\n`).
- Existing blank lines are preserved (no double-processing).
- Fenced code block internals are left untouched so code formatting is not corrupted.

To address ClawSweeper's review feedback, normalization is now applied **after** card/table routing decisions are made on the original text:

- Extracted `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines` into `extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.ts`.
- Reverted `feishuOutbound.chunker` to the raw `chunkTextForOutbound` so `renderMode=card` and auto-mode table detection run on unmodified text.
- Plain text post messages in `sendOutboundText` normalize after routing, then rechunk with `chunkTextForOutbound` against the 4000-character limit.
- `sendChunkedTextReply` normalizes only when falling back to chunked plain text, preserving raw text for upstream card/table decisions.
- `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` still normalizes for edit and direct-send paths; the helper is idempotent, so double-normalization is safe.

This keeps the fix localized to the Feishu plugin while avoiding both markdown-table mis-routing and oversized post chunks after newline expansion.

## User Impact

Feishu channel users will see assistant responses with proper paragraph spacing instead of lines mashed into a single block, without delivery failures on newline-heavy messages near the 4000-character limit. Markdown tables and card-mode content continue to use the existing structured-card path.

## Evidence

Added regression coverage across the Feishu plugin:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
```

Result: 176 tests passed, including:
- `post-markdown.test.ts`: 5 tests for newline upgrade, blank-line preservation, code-block preservation, no-op, and idempotence.
- `send.test.ts`: existing + new regression tests for `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload`.
- `outbound.test.ts`: new tests verifying markdown table routing uses raw text, plain text gets normalized post newlines, and normalized text rechunks within the 4000-character limit.
- `reply-dispatcher.test.ts`: test verifying plain text replies are normalized before chunking while card/table routing stays on raw text.

Formatting check on the changed files:

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.ts extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
```

Result: all matched files use the correct format.

> Note: full `pnpm exec oxlint` is currently blocked in this environment by a project-config/dependency reconciliation issue (`Rule 'no-array-fill-with-reference-type' not found in plugin 'unicorn'` / pnpm install timeout), but `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --disable-unicorn-plugin` on the changed files reports 0 warnings and 0 errors.
